checks.explanation: The 2026 midterm elections have not yet occurred as of the current date, so this cannot be conclusively scored. As of mid-August 2026, Democrats are the clear favorites to retake the House per polling and forecast models (an ~6-8 point lead on the generic congressional ballot, needing only 3 net seat flips), directionally consistent with this prediction, but the outcome itself is not yet determined.

sources.title: 2026 Midterm Election Forecast: Senate & House | Silver Bulletin
